title: soc2-prep-scratchpad-isaac-cho
content:
SOC2 prep scratchpad - control mapping + open questions

Quick context
- Purpose: capture mapping for common SOC2 CCs for Redwood products (hosted API + dedicated). Working notes, not final.
- Scope: production infra, data flows for inference, key service components: API gateways, inference cluster (dedicated), control plane, KMS, observability.
- Audience: internal S+C team + eng owners.

High-level checklist (rough)
- scoping doc + in-scope systems (owner: Isaac) -> need final list from infra (JIRA:SEC-442)
- control mapping table (partial) -> this file
- evidence list (logs, configs, PRs) -> collect per-control
- gap remediation plan -> build backlog tickets

Open questions / notes to self
- Are private (customer-managed) deployments in scope for the same SOC2 report? likely separate. Confirm with legal.
- Do we need separate mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted? Some controls differ re: multi-tenancy risk.
- Evidence retention windows: analytics/metrics retention default is 90 days, SOC2 often expects 12 months for some logs. Confirm acceptable SLO.
- KMS rotation: rotate keys every 12 months? we have automated rotation for service keys but need doc for customer CMKs.

Control mapping (working, high level)
- CC6.1 (Logical Access) -> owners: eng-iam, sre
  - Evidence: user access reviews (quarterly), okta reports, admin role lists, RBAC policies in repo (infra/iam/roles), PRs that changed role mappings.
  - Notes: need export from Okta for 2025-Q2. TODO: ask Maya for report.

- CC7.1 (Change Management) -> owners: release-engineering, platform-engineering
  - Evidence: changelogs, PRs with approvals, deployment runbooks, rollback tests.
  - Gap: we have ad-hoc releases for some infra components (scripts). Need standardized checklist. Create ticket (JIRA:RELEASE-78).

- CC9.2 (System Operations / Monitoring) -> owners: sre, observability
  - Evidence: on-call schedule, alert burn-down, incident postmortems, monitoring config (prometheus rules), runbooks.
  - Notes: ensure PMs link to incidents in Confluence pages.

- CC10.1 (Backup & Recovery) -> owners: infra, platform-engineering
  - Evidence: backup logs, restore tests (last 6 months), S3 lifecycle policies, recovery RTO/RPO doc.
  - TODO: schedule DR drill for dedicated pools (owner: Noah? create ticket).

- CC11.1 (Encryption & KMS) -> owners: security, infra
  - Evidence: KMS policies, key rotation logs, PRs configuring TLS for endpoints, disk encryption configs.
  - Notes: need to produce proof of customer KMS integration for Private deployments.

Evidence artifacts (candidate list)
- okta-access-export-2025Q2.csv (ask Maya)
- admin-role-list.md (repo: infra/iam/roles)
- pr-#512-infra-iam-update (GITHUB:repo-infra#512)
- oncall-schedule-2025.md
- incident-pm-2025-05-12 (Confluence page id: CONFLUENCE:INC-2025-0512)
- backup-restore-test-log-2025-11-03.csv
- kms-rotation-audit-2025.log

Immediate TODOs
- [ ] Confirm final in-scope systems with infra (owner: Isaac) - ping slack #infra, add to JIRA SEC-442
- [ ] Request Okta export for 2025-Q2 (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Create standardized release checklist for infra components (owner: release-engineering, ticket: RELEASE-78)
- [ ] Draft evidence list per control and map owners (owners assigned in this doc but need confirmation)
- [ ] Check retention policy for metrics/logs (who: observability)

Meeting notes to follow up
- sync with Maya + Ryan next Tue 11am PT (agenda: access exports, RBAC mapping)
- weekly 30m triage with infra leads for Q2 remediation items

Risk register (quick)
- Missing retention for critical logs -> medium risk -> mitigation: extend retention + archive to long-term storage
- Admin access not reviewed quarterly -> high risk -> mitigation: enforce quarterly review and automate reminders
- Untracked ad-hoc infra changes -> medium -> mitigation: enforce PR requirement + checklist in release cadence

Draft messages / copy for legal / auditors
- "We maintain quarterly access reviews via Okta and IAM role lists in our infra repo; evidence includes exported reports and PR history."
- "Backups are run nightly; DR drills performed at least annually, with documented restore logs."

Quick references / links
- Confluence SOC2 plan: CONFLUENCE:SEC/SOC2-PLAN-2025
- JIRA backlog: JIRA:SEC-442, RELEASE-78
- GitHub infra PR: GITHUB:repo-infra#512

Notes to self (brain dump)
- Keep this as the canonical scratchpad until we move mapping to Confluence table.
- Try to push owners to add evidence links directly to JIRA tickets to make collection easier.
- Might be easier to generate an S3 archive with all evidence artifacts (zip) and store link in Confluence.

-- end of scratchpad --
